approved_plan.interpretation: The plan explicitly admits scoped supplied reductions and durable scientific inputs, and requires native numerical boundaries rather than independent rederivation of every published IBP. A source-certified exact parent connection transformed by the generic common-mass machinery is a permitted supplied symbolic reduction result for that numerical workflow. Native generic closure and recursive IBPs are actually exercised for boundary subfamilies; the parent supplied connection remains an explicit trust boundary, not an unverified residual silently accepted as a master. Therefore no additional top-level RustRed regeneration is a prerequisite for this scoped notebook gate. Its absence must remain stated and must not be used as evidence of broader automatic-reduction parity.
